data.spec: User explicitly requests synthetic data for the room demo. Root implements additive local demo-only dataset, completely separate from sensor_readings/FacilityEngine/orders/notifications. Server owns seeding through async POST /api/demo/room-environment {board_id:knownboard,action:'seed'|'clear'} under existing mutation_lock; seed repeat idempotent for same board/localdate, clear deletes/disables only its synthetic dataset. Backend helper room_demo.active_dataset(conn,board_id)->metadata|None must be read-only (no table creation), room_demo.seed(conn,board_id,now=None)->{dataset_id,board_id,simulation:true,samples,days,seeded_at,current_values}, room_demo.clear(conn,board_id). Tables room_demo_datasets(id PRIMARY KEY,board_id UNIQUE,bodyJSON) and room_demo_samples(dataset_id,metric,value,at,PRIMARY KEY(dataset_id,metric,at)). 28 prior days, deterministic T/RH/CO2 profiles with hot working-day periods, relative dates; explicit synthetic fixture. RoomConditions prioritizes qualified physical history; fallback to enabled synthetic only when physical history insufficient, never blend sources. Snapshot uses synthetic current preset ONLY when no physical metric is fresh; state:'demo', basis:'synthetic',simulation:true, label in spoken reply, no forgedfreshness. Physical snapshot basis:'physical',simulation:false. History adds basis:'physical'|'synthetic'|'none',simulation:bool,dataset_id:string|null; synthetic recommendation explicitly names demo data. Canonical schemas extended additively. Root owns advisor/API/type/docs integration; bounded seed module/fixture/tests delegated. CLI posts to local API instead of opening live SQLite; no USB/mic/messages/deploy/restart beyond normal dev reload.
